d: Niki's antics off and on set cause nightmares for those around her. Meanwhile, Tasha meets the prosecutor who's about to go against her in the trial.
Niki's multi-million dollar action movie opens, as rumors circulate about her sexuality. Meanwhile, Tasha's military trial ends in a surprise.
As an intense heat wave blankets the city, a love scene sparks jealousy in Jenny. Meanwhile, Bette and Tina decide to see a couples counselor.
The girls attend the Subaru Pink Ride to support breast cancer research and memorialize Dana. News of Niki's relationship with Jenny is made public.
Jodi vows to fight for Bette. Tasha and Alice look for a house together. Finally, Dawn and Cindi deliver a blow that pushes Kit over the edge.
At the wrap-up party for Lez Girls, Jenny thanks the girls for their loyalty and friendship but is about to get a nasty surprise.
In the season premiere, things pick up after the Lez Girls party. Relationships struggle while Helena and Kit celebrate the ownership of a new club.
Old flames popping up for both Bette and Helena complicate their respective lives. Meanwhile, Tasha and Alice try couples counseling.
Tina's troubles with the Lez Girls film continue as the negatives are stolen. Bette and Alice face difficult situations in their professional lives.
Bette and Tina consider another adoption. Tasha and Alice set Helena up with a blind date. Meanwhile, Max and Tom deal with an unexpected pregnancy.
Jenny manages to sell another movie script but its origins are questioned. Despite the girls protesting, Helena plans to go out with Dylan.
Jenny throws an overwhelming baby shower for Max. Meanwhile, Bette and Tina attempt to find ways to work around the Nevada state adoption law.
HIT! hosts a big dance marathon for charity. Tina gets a job offer. Alice begins to suspect there's something going on between Tasha and Jamie.
In the series finale, as the group gathers to celebrate new beginnings, they are rocked when there is a sudden, suspicious death.
Mixing with Bette and Tina's circle of lesbian friends, Jenny learns that she may not be prepared her for life, lust, and love in Los Angeles.
